rf: FRED DTB3 as of each session's open, ACT/360

spec.mechanism: Within a session, a move that exceeds the typical move from the open for that time of day reveals a persistent order imbalance (institutional parent orders worked through the day, leveraged-ETF and option-hedging flows that buy into rises and sell into falls), which continues at the 30–90-minute horizon while the 5–10-minute horizon reverts; a smoothed velocity or a band breakout decided every 30 minutes and held until it reverses earns that continuation, long volatility and flat overnight (Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon 2024; Meyers 2025, 2026).
